caption: The video captures a tight close-up of a bed of burning charcoal, where dark, cracked chunks sit in a fixed pile against a black background. An orange glow seeps steadily from the gaps, while a large rounded coal on the right holds its position throughout. Over these embers, bright yellow flame tongues deform and drift, collapsing from a right-side plume into a central blob and stretching into a horizontal ribbon. The flame mass later rises as a vertical column toward the left before spreading again. Dense streams of fine sparks repeatedly erupt, fanning toward the upper-left and fading, their density swelling and thinning. Individual bright streaks translate diagonally across the frame, distinct from the flame's reshaping. The luminance pulses, flaring into a brilliant yellow core and dimming to wispy tongues. The ember glow and coal placement stay constant beneath this restless activity. The swirling fire and sparking are already underway in the first frame and continue through the last.
relations: Fixed dark cracked chunks and right-side rounded coal persist while orange glow seeps steadily from gaps.
Yellow flame tongues deform and drift, collapsing from a right plume into a central blob then stretching horizontally.
Dense spark streams erupt and fan upper-left, swelling then thinning as individual streaks translate diagonally.
Luminance pulses flaring to a brilliant yellow core and dimming to wispy tongues above the constant ember glow.
